flags.issue: Payment dates given only as a rule ('Approximately the fifth business day following' each Coupon Observation Date); derived with NYSE calendar +5. 'Approximately' wording; final one fixed to maturity date (2028-07-07), consistent with derivation.
Call Observation Dates end March 29, 2028 (interim only); final observation date excluded per filing wording, so 6 levels for obs 2..7.

Example 2 (line ~202-215) calls the first Call Observation Date (2nd Coupon Observation Date) payment the 'second Call Payment Date' - internal inconsistency in the filing's example; terms table (line 96) used.
Converted from cash amount $0.1750 per $10 unit = 1.75% per quarter.
Filing calls it 'Settlement Date' (July 7, 2026); used as issue_date.
Names copied with '®' symbols as they appear (space-separated) in the cleaned text; underlyings are ETFs (DIA, SPY), not indices.
Line 69 boilerplate mentions an 'initial estimated value range' on the cover, but the cover gives a point value $9.827 (line 19); point value used.

scope.reason: Contingent-coupon autocallable with memory, worst-of two equity ETFs (DIA, SPY), quarterly discrete autocall from obs 2, European (final-date-only) 70% barrier with 1-to-1 downside, no buffer.
